meta.name: intel-discipline-advisor
meta.description: Triage a competitive or market question into the right intelligence disciplines, cadence, and executing skill. Use when you know something needs researching but not which channel to run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将市场问题匹配到合适的研究渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常遇到市场问题但不确定从哪开始研究
copy.tagline_en: Match market questions to the right research channels
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face market questions but don't know where to start researching

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先按情况问最多三个问题,再给出 3~5 条编号建议,每条写明用哪几种情报渠道、多久看一次、由哪个技能执行,并说明理由;最后给一张填好的情报分流卡。
howto.when: 当你知道某件事需要调研、但不确定该走哪条情报通道时触发;例如怀疑对手有动作、要新建或刷新市场材料、想设长期监测等。

say.text: 两个资深工程师刚关注了我们 CTO,招聘页也翻倍,该跑哪些情报渠道?
say.note: 已提供的线索算作一个情报信号,并推荐独立渠道交叉印证。

say.text: 每季度只有四小时做竞品情报,这些时间该花在哪?
say.note: 会按可投入时间设定监测节奏,并指定执行技能。

howto.what_en: Claude asks up to three adaptive questions, then gives 3–5 numbered recommendations covering discipline mix, cadence, executing skill, and the reasoning; it ends by offering a filled-in one-page triage card.
howto.when_en: Use when a competitive/market question needs research but the right channel is unclear: suspected competitor move, artifact to refresh, or standing watch.

say_en.text: Intel discipline advisor: suspect a competitor move, unsure where to look first.
say_en.note: It asks questions, then gives numbered recommendations.

say_en.text: Two senior engineers followed our CTO; careers page doubled. Which channels?
say_en.note: Seen signal counts; other picks are independent.

say_en.text: Only four hours this quarter for competitor intel—where should they go?
say_en.note: Sets a feasible cadence and names the executing skill.
